agent.notes: The PR adds new methods (Inspector.purge_worker, PrometheusMetrics.remove_worker_metrics, Flower._purge_offline_workers) that don't exist in base. Its only edits to existing code are one attribute set in __init__ and starting/stopping a PeriodicCallback timer in Flower.start/stop. Reaching those needs a full broker-backed server start, and the timer's interval is at least 10 s, so the new purge callback would never run within the time limit. Nothing meaningful can run on both versions. Install logs were not checked and check.py was not run.
